title: Bloons Blitz
short_description: A survivor-style roguelike road trip across the Bloons universe, battling waves of Bloons with one-handed controls.
description: A road trip adventure across the Bloons universe. Fast-paced, survivor-style roguelike action pits you against relentless waves of Bloons using intuitive one-handed controls. Play as Bloons Heroes, each with their own signature weapon and playstyle, recruit Monkeys to join your team, and pick upgrades each run to build a versatile squad or go deep on a single path.
